root_cause.result: The REAL session started and the board guard became ready, but the App timed out before receiving manual_mapping_session_id and therefore did not navigate to the joystick page.
root_cause.follow_on_risk: The preparation page remained retryable and two later attempts failed against the already active mapping operation.
root_cause.fix: Use a bounded 55 second timeout only for POST /api/v1/navigation/mapping-operations; retain the 20 second base timeout for every other paired REST route.
